name: Tong Tong AI Social Group Limited
summary: Tong Tong AI Social Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides various financial services in Hong Kong and the People's Republic of China. The company offers commercial factoring, financial leasing, personal property pawn loans, real estate mortgage loans, and money lending services. It also provides consultancy services. The company was formerly known as Sino Credit Holdings Limited and changed its name to Tong Tong AI Social Group Limited in February 2017. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong. Tong Tong AI Social Group Limited is a subsidiary of Swiree Capital Limited.
